looks.reason: Swiss style provides precise high-density typography and clear information grids suited for commercial IoT telemetry monitoring.
Minimal recipe highlights critical sensor excursions and clear operational status with hairline dividers.

requested.words: clean and technical, light background, a leaf green accent

design.reason: Verdant Greenhouse Monitor requires dense, actionable telemetry tables and cards for fast review of environmental excursions and device health.
replaced: Zone: meta 'location' left out (no such field)
look 'neon' left out: a neon look does not suit this product
look 'enterprise' replaced by 'glass': three quiet looks offer no choice

tours.name: Monitor Climate and Acknowledge Alerts
tours.outcome: Zone environmental excursions are identified and acknowledged by an operator

steps.title: Inspect zone dashboard and 24-hour sensor trends (the reading becomes reviewed). Rule: Readings must display latest values and 24-hour historical charts
Trigger alert on rule violation (the alert becomes active). Rule: Alert triggers when conditions exceed configured threshold duration
Acknowledge active alert (the alert becomes acknowledged). Rule: Only active alerts can be acknowledged

tours.name: Review Pest Detections
tours.outcome: Camera pest detections are validated to guide greenhouse pest interventions

steps.title: Inspect pest detection snapshot and confidence score (the detection becomes reviewed). Rule: Detections must include snapshot image and model confidence score
Confirm pest detection (the detection becomes confirmed). Rule: Confirmed detections validate pest presence on bench

tours.name: Manage Device Health
tours.outcome: Unhealthy or offline monitoring devices are restored to maintain telemetry

steps.title: Review device connectivity and battery status (the device becomes flagged). Rule: Flags devices that are offline or have low battery
Send reboot command to device (the device becomes rebooting). Rule: Only admins can issue remote device reboot commands
